mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers a labor market recovery signal, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust demand-side expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are negative despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising above their 50th percentile in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 forward returns are negatively correlated with the rate's trajectory over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in >50% of instances during tightening cycles, or FEDFUNDS show no upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 triggers a supply-driven growth signal, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 105.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns are negative despite both PAYEMS rising and UNRATE declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are negative despite INDPRO showing a positive 3-month trend.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (evidenced by high GDP growth), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) amplifies equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle periods despite FEDFUNDS easing.
